answer: A numbered vine is trained along a juniper trellis on a ledge; one pruned shoot is the proof. The holder prunes a shoot at a marked node, seals the cut with a numbered wax tag and photographs it with the date. Two verifiers visit within 24 hours and match tag and cut; a shoot never pruned there or a duplicate number locks and burns the deposit. One cut is cheap; 100 fakes need 100 trellises and 100 trips.
